translations.whatsNew.title: What's new
translations.whatsNew.heading: What's new: each release note, checked
translations.whatsNew.intro: Each case takes one line of an ng-native release note, runs it live, and says what was seen on a simulator and an emulator.
translations.whatsNew.a10_1.title: Dialogs.choose() on Cancel
translations.whatsNew.a10_1.note: On iOS, picking Cancel or dismissing the sheet resolves null, as on Android.
translations.whatsNew.a10_2.title: Deep link pushed over the screen
translations.whatsNew.a10_2.note: A link that arrives while the app runs is pushed over the screen showing, and Back returns to it.
translations.whatsNew.a10_3.title: ng-deep after a selector
translations.whatsNew.a10_3.note: A rule written as host, then ng-deep, then .inner styles .inner in the components the host holds; with nothing before ng-deep it is still dropped.
translations.whatsNew.a10_4.title: dark class on the root view
translations.whatsNew.a10_4.note: dark: applies to the view that has the dark class itself, not only to what is inside it.
translations.whatsNew.a10_5.title: Border with no color
translations.whatsNew.a10_5.note: A border with a width and no color is drawn in the text color, not black.
translations.whatsNew.a10_6.title: One long word
translations.whatsNew.a10_6.note: A single word is one line cut at the box edge, not wrapped between letters; several words still wrap.
translations.whatsNew.a10_7.title: z-index across plain views
translations.whatsNew.a10_7.note: A box with a z-index is drawn over what follows the plain views it sits in.
translations.whatsNew.unknown: No cases for this version yet.
translations.whatsNew.a10_4.box: The box itself has the class
translations.whatsNew.a10_4.on: dark class: on (the background should be near black)
translations.whatsNew.a10_4.off: dark class: off (the background should be white)
translations.whatsNew.a10_2.how: With this screen showing, send the app a link from a terminal, then press Back in the header.
translations.whatsNew.a10_2.expected: Expected: the Device demo opens over this screen, and Back returns here, not to an earlier screen.
translations.whatsNew.a10_1.hint: Pick Save or Discard to see an index. Pick Cancel to see null; on iOS, tapping outside the sheet does too.
translations.whatsNew.a10_3.with: Something before ng-deep: should be crimson
translations.whatsNew.a10_3.bare: Nothing before ng-deep: should stay gray
translations.whatsNew.a10_6.hint: Expected: the word on one line, cut at the edge of its box; the three words on three lines.
translations.whatsNew.a10_7.hint: Expected, from the top: 3, then 2, then 1, whatever the order in the tree.
translations.whatsNew.a9_1.title: ICU plurals, selects and i18n- attributes
translations.whatsNew.a9_1.note: Plurals and selects render on iOS and Android, translated or not, and an i18n- attribute keeps its text.
translations.whatsNew.a9_2.title: Same-named keyframes in two components
translations.whatsNew.a9_2.note: Two components that each define @keyframes of the same name each play their own.
translations.whatsNew.a9_3.title: Keyframes with var() and em, opening a panel
translations.whatsNew.a9_3.note: A keyframe value can be a var() or an em, so to height var(--panel-height) opens each panel to the height set on it.
translations.whatsNew.a9_4.title: Press on a view faded to opacity 0
translations.whatsNew.a9_4.note: A view that takes a touch and fades to opacity 0 by a transition still hears a press on iOS.
translations.whatsNew.a9_5.title: tw-animate-css animate-in
translations.whatsNew.a9_5.note: animate-in fade-in-0 zoom-in-95 duration-200 fades and zooms in over 200 ms where the animation was dropped.
translations.whatsNew.a9_5.hint: Show the cards: both fade and zoom in; the second takes 1.5 s so a frame can be caught halfway.
translations.whatsNew.a9_1.count: {VAR_PLURAL, plural, =0 {No rewards} one {{INTERPOLATION} reward} other {{INTERPOLATION} rewards}}
translations.whatsNew.a9_1.tier: {VAR_SELECT, select, gold {Gold member} silver {Silver member} other {Member}}
translations.whatsNew.a9_1.hint: Step from 0 to 1 to 5 and the sentence changes case; Spanish picks its case by its own rules. The counter's accessibility label comes from an i18n- attribute.
translations.whatsNew.a9_4.hint: Tap Fade it out, wait a moment, then tap where the red button was. The counter should still go up.
translations.whatsNew.a9_2.hint: Blue should grow to 1.6 times its size; green should slide right by 80 points. Both are named pulse.
translations.whatsNew.a9_3.hint: Expected heights: 40, 96 and 64 points (4em at 16 points). Closed, all three are 0.
translations.whatsNew.a8_1.title: Permission.ensure() checks again after Settings
translations.whatsNew.a8_1.note: A refused permission that is turned on in Settings works on the next ensure(), and blocked() changes by itself when the app comes back, with no dialog and no restart.
translations.whatsNew.a8_2.title: Transitions that survive Block JS
translations.whatsNew.a8_2.note: A CSS transition of opacity, a transform or a size is played by native, so it keeps moving while JavaScript is busy; two boxes resized in one commit are eased from JavaScript.
translations.whatsNew.a8_3.title: Padding, margin and radius transitions
translations.whatsNew.a8_3.note: A transition eases a padding, a margin or a border-radius that no rule sets from or to 0, where it jumped.
translations.whatsNew.a8_4.title: A gradient held by a custom property
translations.whatsNew.a8_4.note: background: var(--x) draws a linear-gradient that a custom property set on the element holds; background-color: var(--x) is a colour or nothing.
translations.whatsNew.a8_5.title: Icon size in px and rem
translations.whatsNew.a8_5.note: An icon's size is read as 18px or 1.5rem; one that cannot be read is left the size of the text around it.
translations.whatsNew.a8_6.title: not-dark: in dark mode
translations.whatsNew.a8_6.note: not-dark: with the class-based dark variant no longer applies in dark mode.
translations.whatsNew.a8_5.hint: Expected: 18px draws at 18 points, 1.5rem at 24, 24 at 24; the last one cannot be read and takes the size of the text around it.
translations.whatsNew.a8_6.dark: Scheme: dark (the swatch should be zinc)
translations.whatsNew.a8_6.light: Scheme: light (the swatch should be amber)
translations.whatsNew.a8_1.hint: Refuse Location for this app, leave for Settings, turn it on, and come back: blocked should go to no by itself, with no dialog and no restart.
translations.whatsNew.a8_3.hint: Open should ease padding to 20, margin to 20 and the corner radius to 40 over 2 s, and Close ease them back, not jump.
translations.whatsNew.a8_2.idle: Press an Animate button, then Block JS, and watch which boxes keep moving.
translations.whatsNew.a8_2.done: JavaScript was blocked. Blocks so far: {$count}
translations.whatsNew.a8_2.sizeTitle: Width and height, alone in the commit
translations.whatsNew.a11_1.title: DeepLinks.openSettings()
translations.whatsNew.a11_1.note: DeepLinks.openSettings() opens the app's own page in the system settings, where to send a person once a permission is blocked.
translations.whatsNew.a11_2.title: Back to the tab in front while another loads
translations.whatsNew.a11_2.note: Tapping back to the tab in front while a tap on another tab is still loading stays on the tab in front, instead of the other tab opening when it finishes.
translations.whatsNew.a11_3.title: Tab bar under a route with a parameter
translations.whatsNew.a11_3.note: A tab bar kept as one screen with reuseScreen under org/:org opens a tab in the account in front, not the one it was last on.
translations.whatsNew.a13_1.title: Icons with mask, clipPath and use
translations.whatsNew.a13_1.note: NgIcon draws mask, clipPath and use: a duotone icon is not a solid square, a flag keeps its emblem and stays inside its edge.
translations.whatsNew.a13_2.title: Icon color from a token
translations.whatsNew.a13_2.note: color="var(--accent)" resolves against the tokens in scope, where it was sent to native as the text var(--accent).
translations.whatsNew.a13_3.title: provideNgIconsConfig
translations.whatsNew.a13_3.note: provideNgIconsConfig({ size, color, strokeWidth }) sets the default of each; an icon's own input still wins.
translations.whatsNew.a13_4.title: provideNgIconLoader with caching
translations.whatsNew.a13_4.note: provideNgIconLoader is asked for a name no provideIcons has, and can answer with a string, a promise or an observable; withCaching() asks it once per name.
translations.whatsNew.a13_5.title: aria-label on an icon
translations.whatsNew.a13_5.note: A static aria-label labels the icon for a screen reader, as accessibilityLabel does.
translations.whatsNew.a13_6.title: --ng-icon__size
translations.whatsNew.a13_6.note: With no size, an icon takes --ng-icon__size when something around it sets it.
translations.whatsNew.a13_7.title: stroke-dasharray none and opacity 50%
translations.whatsNew.a13_7.note: stroke-dasharray="none" draws a solid line, and an opacity written as a percentage, opacity="50%", is read as a fraction.
translations.whatsNew.a13_8.title: preventNativeDismiss on a page from another tab
translations.whatsNew.a13_8.note: A page presented from another tab refuses Android's Back button while it sets preventNativeDismiss, and hears nativeDismissCancelled.
translations.whatsNew.a11_2.steps: Open the lab. Press Search, whose route waits 4 seconds behind a guard, then press Home at once.
translations.whatsNew.a11_2.expected: Expected: when the 4 seconds pass, Home is still in front and Search never opens. Before: Search opened when it finished.
translations.whatsNew.a11_3.steps: Open the lab (org 1). In Library press Open album x, then in Home press Go to org 2, then press Library.
translations.whatsNew.a11_3.expected: Expected: Library opens at org 2's first page, not at org 1's album x. Before: it went back to org 1's url.
translations.whatsNew.a13_8.steps: Android. Open the lab. On Home press Present a Library page, then press the system Back button.
translations.whatsNew.a13_8.expected: Expected: the sheet stays up and Back refused goes to 1; Close leaves. Before: Back closed the sheet.
translations.whatsNew.a13_2.hint: Expected: the pin is drawn in the colour --accent holds, and changes with the button.
translations.whatsNew.a13_3.hint: Expected: the first pin draws at 28 points, blue, with a heavy line; the second keeps its own 44. Before: the config was ignored.
translations.whatsNew.a13_5.hint: Expected: the red pin is read as an image named "Pin on the map"; the gray one is skipped by a screen reader. Before: neither was an accessibility element.
translations.whatsNew.a13_4.hint: Expected: two pins and a ring appear, the loader is asked twice (one per name, not three times), and drawing again asks nothing more.
translations.whatsNew.a13_1.hint: Expected: a square with a round hole, a circle with a stripe (nothing past the circle), and two stars. Before: a solid square, a full square, no stars.
translations.whatsNew.a13_6.hint: Expected: the first pin draws at 32 points; the second, with nothing around it, at the text size (16).
translations.whatsNew.a13_7.hint: Expected: the top line is dashed, the two under it are solid; the first bar is dark, and the 0.5 and 50% bars are the same pale tone.
translations.whatsNew.a11_1.hint: Expected: the system Settings open on this app's own page. Come back with the app switcher or Back; the app keeps running.
translations.repro.v4.label: Count
translations.whatsNew.a14_1.title: Bound size in em, rem and vw
translations.whatsNew.a14_1.note: [style.width]="'2em'" is measured against the font size in scope and follows it, '2rem' is 32 points, '50vw' follows the viewport, and an ng-icon size in em is drawn at that many em.
translations.whatsNew.a14_2.title: A class brings in the transition and the value
translations.whatsNew.a14_2.note: A class change that brings in a transition together with the value it eases animates from the old value, where out of transition: none or no transition at all it jumped.
translations.whatsNew.a14_3.title: Border colour before its width
translations.whatsNew.a14_3.note: A border given its width or style after its colour is drawn in that colour on Android; a box given one later was drawn with a black border.
translations.whatsNew.a14_4.title: aspect-ratio across a flex line
translations.whatsNew.a14_4.note: A view with an aspect-ratio that stretches across its flex line is as wide as its column, as in a browser.
translations.whatsNew.a14_5.title: A minimum over a maximum
translations.whatsNew.a14_5.note: A min-height or min-width over a max-height or max-width wins, and so do a box's padding and border over a max.
translations.whatsNew.a14_6.title: Wrapped lines stretch
translations.whatsNew.a14_6.note: The lines of a wrapping flex container that says nothing of align-content stretch across it, so an item that stretches across its line has a size.
translations.whatsNew.a14_7.title: Truncated text written into a view
translations.whatsNew.a14_7.note: A view's truncate or line-clamp-2 around its own words cuts them, as a browser cuts a block's own text.
translations.whatsNew.a14_8.title: A flex-col label of spans
translations.whatsNew.a14_8.note: A label that is a flex column of two spans stacks them one under the other, where they ran on as one line.
translations.whatsNew.a14_9.title: aria-checked="false" as an attribute
translations.whatsNew.a14_9.note: aria-checked written as an attribute reaches native as a boolean; aria-checked="false" was announced as checked.
translations.whatsNew.a14_10.title: CSS system colours on Android
translations.whatsNew.a14_10.note: Text in CanvasText, FieldText, ButtonText and GrayText shows on Android, where it drew nothing.
translations.whatsNew.a14_11.title: Number inputs bound to undefined
translations.whatsNew.a14_11.note: A number input with a default keeps it when bound to undefined: delayLongPress waits the usual 500 ms, and a virtual-list with rowGap unset lays out.
translations.whatsNew.a14_12.title: CSS in a style attribute
translations.whatsNew.a14_12.note: style="padding: 4px 8px" sets each side, and a unitless line-height in a style is a multiple of the font size, as in a stylesheet.
translations.whatsNew.a14_9.hint: Expected in the accessibility tree: the first checkbox is not checked, the second is.
translations.whatsNew.a14_3.hint: Press the button: both borders should appear seagreen, not black (Android).
translations.whatsNew.a14_1.hint: Expected at font size 16: 2em is 32, 2rem is 32, 50vw is half the screen width, the icon 32. At 24: 48, 32, the same, 48.
translations.whatsNew.a14_8.hint: Expected: the first two labels (a rule in a sheet, and the Tailwind classes flex flex-col) are two lines tall, Name above Hint; the plain one is one line.
translations.whatsNew.a14_11.hint: Hold the button: the long press should be heard after about 500 ms. The three rows under the button should be drawn.
translations.whatsNew.a14_5.hint: Expected: height 80 (min over max 40), width 160 (min over max 100), box 36 (16+16 padding and 2+2 border over max 20).
translations.whatsNew.a14_12.hint: Expected: the red square starts at x 8, y 4; the 20 pt text line is 30 tall.
translations.whatsNew.a14_10.hint: Expected: four words in the text colour (on Android GrayText is the same colour, it has no grey of its own).
translations.whatsNew.a14_2.lane1: 1. opacity and transform, no transition before
translations.whatsNew.a14_2.lane2: 2. opacity and transform, transition: none before
translations.whatsNew.a14_2.hint: Press once and watch 6 s: each lane should ease to its end. Pressing again goes back with a jump, the base rule has no transition.
translations.whatsNew.a14_7.hint: Expected: the first cut to one line with an ellipsis, the second to two, the third in full (a few lines taller).
translations.whatsNew.a14_6.hint: Expected: four squares-to-be that fill the box, two lines of 80. Before: items with no height drew nothing.
translations.whatsNew.linkLab.title: Page B
translations.whatsNew.linkLab.replace: Link to Page B with replaceUrl
translations.whatsNew.linkLab.readout: Copies of Page B: {$pageB} / of the 0.7 page: {$pageA}
translations.whatsNew.linkLab.heading: Page B
translations.whatsNew.a7_3.readout: Copies of this page on the stack: {$copies}
translations.whatsNew.a7_3.hint: Open Page B, then press its first link, back to this page. A new copy of this screen opens over Page B and the count goes to 2; Back returns to Page B. Page B's second link swaps Page B for a new one and its count stays at 1.
translations.whatsNew.a7_1.title: A bottom toolbar on iOS
translations.whatsNew.a7_1.note: native-toolbar with native-toolbar-item buttons (an SF Symbol or a title, and a press output) and a spacer is the screen's bottom toolbar on iOS 18; Android draws nothing.
translations.whatsNew.a7_2.title: endReached on a short list
translations.whatsNew.a7_2.note: A virtual-list fires endReached when its rows are shorter than the viewport, and again when a page is appended while it rests at the end, without waiting for a drag; viewableItemsChanged reports again when the items change.
translations.whatsNew.a7_3.title: A link to a url already on the stack
translations.whatsNew.a7_3.note: A nativeRouterLink to a url that is already on the stack pushes a new screen over it, and Back returns to the page the link was on, where the press popped back to the earlier screen; a link whose extras set replaceUrl replaces the screen.
translations.whatsNew.a7_4.title: Transitions from the initial value
translations.whatsNew.a7_4.note: A transition of an opacity or a background-color that no rule sets runs from or to the initial value (1 and transparent), also with transition: all; it jumped.
translations.whatsNew.a7_5.title: A unitless line-height is inherited as the number
translations.whatsNew.a7_5.note: Under a card with font-size 10px and line-height 2, a text with font-size 20px has lines 40 points tall, where it took the card's 20.
translations.whatsNew.a7_6.title: Markdown: wrapped lines and every entity
translations.whatsNew.a7_6.note: markdown no longer breaks a paragraph where its source wrapped a line, decodes every named HTML entity such as → and ♥, and still breaks at two spaces or a backslash.
translations.whatsNew.a7_5.hint: Left: line-height 2 on a 10 px card. Right: line-height 20px. Expected heights: 120 and about 60 points.
translations.whatsNew.a7_4.hint: Press once and watch 5 s: lanes 1 and 2 fade out, lane 3 fills in. Press again and each comes back the same way. A jump is the old behaviour.
translations.whatsNew.a7_6.drawnTitle: The same file, drawn by markdown
translations.whatsNew.a7_6.hint: Expected: the three source lines read as one paragraph, each entity is its glyph (an arrow, e with an accent, euro, a heart, an ampersand, an apostrophe), and the text breaks twice: after the two spaces and after the backslash.
translations.whatsNew.a7_2.hint: Do not touch the list. Three rows are shorter than it, and the counter should climb to 4 by itself, with 12 rows at the end.
translations.whatsNew.a7_1.hint: Look at the bottom of the screen: a plus button at the left and Clear at the right. Each press is counted here. On Android nothing is drawn.
translations.whatsNew.a6_1.title: display: none has no native view
translations.whatsNew.a6_1.note: An element that is display: none has no native view, nor has anything inside it, so what a view holds of its own, such as a scroll offset, is lost; position: absolute with opacity: 0 and pointer-events: none keeps the view.
translations.whatsNew.a6_2.title: A .md file drawn by markdown
translations.whatsNew.a6_2.note: A .md file is a module, import post from './post.md' is { attributes, content, tokens } lexed by marked as the app is bundled, and markdown draws the tokens as native text and views: headings, nested emphasis, lists, tables, code blocks and links.
translations.whatsNew.a6_3.title: rows on a multiline text-input
translations.whatsNew.a6_3.note: rows on a multiline text-input sizes it: that many lines of its line height, with its padding and border.
translations.whatsNew.a6_4.title: flex-basis that changes after layout
translations.whatsNew.a6_4.note: A flex-basis that changes after a view is first laid out is followed, and a percentage flex-basis follows the box it is a share of.
translations.whatsNew.a6_5.title: virtual-list with a header and a footer
translations.whatsNew.a6_5.note: A virtual-list with listHeader or listFooter content no longer stops the app on Android with "ScrollView can host only one direct child".
translations.whatsNew.a6_6.title: Keyframes that native plays
translations.whatsNew.a6_6.note: A @keyframes animation that moves an element by a percentage of its own size, or whose transform gains or loses a function between frames, is played by native, so it keeps moving while JavaScript is busy.
translations.whatsNew.a6_7.title: var() with a several-part fallback
translations.whatsNew.a6_7.note: border-radius: var(--r, 50% 50% 50% 0) gives each corner its own radius, margin: var(--gap, 0 24px) takes each side from its part, and transform: var(--t, translateX(...) rotate(...)) takes the list, where they were dropped or discarded.
translations.whatsNew.a6_8.title: A press on an invisible view (iOS)
translations.whatsNew.a6_8.note: A view that is pressed and has opacity: 0 takes the press on iOS, as it does on Android and in a browser.
translations.whatsNew.a6_9.title: light-dark() and color-mix() with a token
translations.whatsNew.a6_9.note: light-dark() in a Tailwind-preset stylesheet is the two colour schemes it names, and a color-mix() whose share is a token mixes by the token's value.
translations.whatsNew.a6_1.readout: Laid out: display none {$left} times / opacity {$right} times

translations.offline.title: Offline
translations.offline.heading: Works without a connection
translations.offline.intro: The catalog and the history are saved on the phone in SQLite. Redeem with no network and the redemption waits in a queue until the connection returns.
translations.offline.catalog.title: CATALOG
translations.offline.catalog.empty: No catalog saved on this phone.
translations.offline.history.title: HISTORY
translations.offline.history.empty: No history saved on this phone.
translations.offline.lab.title: LAB
translations.offline.clear.title: Clear local data?
translations.offline.clear.message: This deletes the saved catalog and history and every redemption on this phone, including those not yet sent.
translations.offline.lab.simHint: Behaves exactly like having no network. A simulator cannot lose its network on its own.
translations.offline.lab.failHint: The fake server answers every request with a 500. Redemptions stay queued and are tried again.
translations.offline.redemptions.title: YOUR REDEMPTIONS
translations.offline.status.title: CONNECTION
translations.offline.status.never: Nothing saved yet. Connect once to download the catalog.
translations.offline.status.error: The server failed. Trying again soon.
translations.offline.status.storageError: Could not save on this phone. What you see may be lost on restart.
translations.whatsNew.a15_1.title: Colours made of tokens
translations.whatsNew.a15_1.note: A bound colour made of tokens, color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand), white 20%) or a relative colour such as color(from var(--brand) srgb r g b), is worked out where it is used; it reached native as text and painted nothing.
translations.whatsNew.a15_2.title: Text input events on Android
translations.whatsNew.a15_2.note: (scroll) and (keyPress) on a text-input, and (contentSizeChange) on a multiline one, fire on Android, where the native field was never asked to send them.
translations.whatsNew.a15_3.title: A markdown table that scrolls sideways
translations.whatsNew.a15_3.note: A markdown table wider than the page scrolls sideways, each column as wide as its widest cell (up to 280pt), instead of squeezing every column into the page.
translations.whatsNew.a15_4.title: Markdown that streams in
translations.whatsNew.a15_4.note: markdown takes a streaming input for a source that arrives a chunk at a time, holding back what has not closed yet: a code span, emphasis, a link, an image, a table row or a code fence's opening line.
translations.whatsNew.a15_5.title: A base64 picture in markdown
translations.whatsNew.a15_5.note: markdown draws an image written as a base64 data: url of a raster picture, PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP; an SVG data: url is still its alt text.
translations.whatsNew.a15_6.title: NavigationBar claims on Android
translations.whatsNew.a15_6.note: NavigationBar in @ng-native/device is a stack of claims on Android's navigation bar: style picks light or dark buttons, hidden hides the bar until a swipe. Expo Go has expo-navigation-bar; on iOS the claims change nothing.
translations.whatsNew.a15_7.title: :has() with an ancestor test in a list
translations.whatsNew.a15_7.note: A :has() whose argument is a list with an ancestor test, such as .card:has(.x:is(.p *, .y)), matches either alternative, as a browser does, instead of needing both.
translations.whatsNew.a15_8.title: :host:has() follows a change beneath the host
translations.whatsNew.a15_8.note: A :has() rule in a component's own styles, such as :host:has(.on), now follows a change beneath the host, where it kept what it matched before.
translations.whatsNew.a15_9.title: No transition before the first frame
translations.whatsNew.a15_9.note: A class added to a view before a frame has drawn it no longer starts a transition, as in a browser; Spartan's sheet appeared with a 200 ms fade from transparent. A change made once the view has been drawn eases as before.
translations.whatsNew.a15_10.title: An unreadable SVG paint
translations.whatsNew.a15_10.note: An SVG shape whose fill or stroke contains a colour React Native cannot read, such as a custom property set to a typo, is drawn with no paint of its own instead of stopping the app.

translations.whatsNew.a16_1.title: A markdown picture at its own size
translations.whatsNew.a16_1.note: A markdown image is drawn at its own size once it loads, as a browser draws it, and is narrowed to the document's width, keeping its shape, only when it is wider; a small icon keeps its size.
translations.whatsNew.a16_1.hint: Expected: the small icon keeps its own 32 pt size, and the wide strip is narrowed to the card's width, keeping its 6 to 1 shape. Before, both filled the card's width.
